title: Ellaz campaign file
description: A campaign is worlds of stages (2026-09-13): each world is a list of mode ids, in play order, every one a FIGHT mode naming a stage file - the engine already plays, tapes, hashes and gates each stage on its own, so a campaign is one more data file and no new rule. A world opens when the one before it is cleared; the purse (coins, xp, level) a stage ends with is what the next stage is created with. The schema holds the shape; that every stage resolves to a stage mode is data/load.ts loadCampaign's job (a schema validates a string, only the filesystem knows what it names).

id.description: must equal the file's basename; the save is keyed on it
recorded in the save's `cleared` list; never rename one

stages.description: basenames under ../modes/, in play order; the last is the world's boss
